Tomorrow, Friday, 27 November 2026, NOAA expects a magnetic storm – minor geomagnetic storm (G1). The highest Kp index of the day is 5.0, with the peak between 05:00 and 08:00 Bulgarian time (EET).

Minor storm: weak power grid fluctuations and aurora over Northern Europe are possible; in Bulgaria there are usually no visible effects. Most people feel nothing.

A magnetic storm means a Kp index of 5 or more (G1 on the NOAA scale). At Kp 4 the field is unsettled, but this is not a storm yet. The forecast comes from the NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center and is updated here every morning; the current value is in the box below. Magnetic storms are global: the Kp index is the same for all of Europe.
